description: Oscillator building six pulse waves an octave apart from one core, each with its own level slider, level CV and output

params.text: Attenuates the PWM input, from nothing through to its full effect
Sets the fundamental in octave steps, from C1 at 32.7Hz up to C7
Tunes the pitch, reaching 4 octaves either way on Full, 1 octave on Octave and 1 semitone on Semitone
Sets the pulse width of every octave, from 50% down to 0%
Picks how far the TUNE knob reaches: Full for 4 octaves either way, Octave for 1 octave, or Semitone for 1 semitone
Sets the level of that octave in the sum, from silence to full

inputs.text: Volt-per-octave pitch, added to the other V/OCT input and to the tuning controls
A rising edge here resets the core half way through its cycle, which hard-syncs all six octaves together
Modulates the pulse width of every octave, -10V to 10V covering the whole range, after the PWM attenuator
Scales the level of that octave, 0-10V spanning silence to the full level its slider sets; with nothing patched the level is whatever the slider says

outputs.text: Carries that octave's wave added to every lower octave whose own output has no cable, at 10V peak to peak

menu: Limit pulsewidth (5%-95%) — holds every octave's pulse between 5% and 95% wide; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
Oversampling — runs the oscillator above the sample rate to cut aliasing: Off, x2, x4 or x8, with x4 the default
Remove pulse DC — takes out the DC offset that a narrow pulse gives the outputs; off by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
Use triangle core — swaps the pulse core for a triangle core; off by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
